card.name: Monsivais surname and scattered commas
card.fires_on: Most strongly on the "iv" inside the surname Monsivais in news quotes. Weaker on commas that introduce a list or elaboration, and on "is" after "There" in a treatment-guideline sentence.

modes.label: Comma before elaboration
modes.description: A comma after a noun that is followed by an example list or explanatory phrase.

modes.label: There is no agreement
modes.description: The word "is" right after "There" in a sentence saying no general agreement exists on treatment.
